source.chapter_context: Shared-book Imperial Fists profile. Chapter roster restrictions and Chapter-specific effects are outside this local datasheet scope.
source.game_mode: Standard Warhammer 40,000 11th edition through the local match/action runtime; this is not full-match certification.

fixed_data_comparison.scope: Fixed numeric, identity, keyword, default loadout, composition, base and cost checks. The source option table has no Tor rows; ability interactions and construction admission are checked by the dedicated local suite.

scope: One 90-point model on a 40 mm base, exact source profile, fixed weapons and no equipment-option rows.
Artificer Grav-gun and Hand of Defiance checked through Equipment; both AttackPlans carry Siege Captain against a Vehicle target, and Anti-Vehicle 2+ remains on the grav-gun.
Current consolidated catalog admission at 90 points, unique-copy cap, and prepared materialization from the current local Space Marines catalog for both players.
Leader, Combat Doctrines, Transhuman Strategist, Siege Captain and Signum Array registration; all four source-listed Leader links are exercised by the paired 153-link suite.
Warlord eligibility and Transhuman Strategist CP once per battle round.
Siege Captain +2 Strength/AP/Damage against Vehicle, Monster and Fortification, with a normal-target exclusion.
Signum Array visible-target choice, public command, owner rejection, selected-target-only cover denial through AttackPlan, single-use limit and Shooting-phase expiry.
limits: Closes only Tor Garadon's shared-book local datasheet scope.
Imperial Fists Chapter roster rules and detachment effects are outside this scope.
Full faction/army legality, Chapter-book variants, Forge World, Legends, Boarding Actions, network behavior, complete-match certification and human playtesting remain open.
